To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) surge pricing is useful for managing supply and demand in a zone with surplus supply; and (2) surge pricing can be a mechanism for credible forecast communication.

1) surge pricing is useful not only in zones with excess demand, but also in zones with excess supply; 2) when there are zones with excess demand and zones with excess supply, the platform can increase its total profit by strategically setting the surge price in a zone where supply exceeds demand; 3) the platform can make its forecast communication credible by strategically setting the price in zones with excess supplies.

1) when the platform has to rely on independent workers to supply services across multiple zones, surge pricing may be used in zones with excess supply; 2) when the supply of workers across zones is fixed, surge pricing may not be used in zones where demand exceeds supply; 3) the platform may have incentives to misreport market conditions to workers; 4) the platform may use surge pricing to credibly communicate market conditions to workers.
